followUps.title: Wire promotions-api and promotionsdb into AppHost (and teststack)
followUps.reason: src/eShop.AppHost/AppHost.cs has no promotionsdb or promotions-api resource, so the service cannot start under Aspire; this is outside the service subtask's owns.

followUps.title: Register 'promotions' ApiResource/ApiScope (and swagger client) in Identity.API Config.cs
followUps.reason: Identity:Audience=promotions needs a matching resource and scope for tokens used on GET /api/promotions.

followUps.title: Associate testing/teststack.json with the JSONC language mode in the LSP/editor config
followUps.reason: The generic JSON language server reports false 'comments not permitted' errors on this intentionally JSONC file, which blocks the verifier on any future change to it.

followUps.title: Associate testing/teststack.json with the JSONC language mode
followUps.reason: The LSP reports 'Comments are not permitted in JSON' on a file the tooling intentionally treats as JSONC; mapping it to JSONC would stop the false errors for future subtasks.

findings.issue: DATA-001 Applied EF Core migrations are immutable: Applied migration was modified. Add a new migration instead.

reason: DATA-001 is a false positive from the review tooling (it passes changed_files without git statuses, so the engine marks every file, including the newly added PromotionRuleModel migration, as modified), and the policy gate blocks before disputes are ruled on, so no change to the story's code can clear it.

followUps.title: Tenant-scope promotions (story's multi-tenancy section)
followUps.reason: No tenant concept exists in the codebase yet; the admin API should filter by and stamp the current tenant once the multi-tenancy epic adds one.

followUps.title: Outbox has no retry for failed promotion events
followUps.reason: Events marked PublishedFailed in IntegrationEventLog are never re-sent (same as Catalog.API); a start or end event lost to a RabbitMQ outage stays lost.
